landing.headline: Tuition, organized.
landing.subhead: Classes, attendance, payments, and parent updates — in one place for institutes, teachers, and families.
landing.featuresBody: Everything institutes need to run classes smoothly — from attendance to parent messaging.

features.f1Body: Scan a student QR and mark present in seconds. Timetables stay in sync so teachers and parents always know who’s in class.
features.f2Body: Collect class fees and manage teacher wallets with clear records.
features.f3Body: Updates, chats, and student progress in one parent-friendly app.

errors.mfaNetworkFailed: Cannot reach the superadmin verification service. Deploy the Edge Function superadmin-mfa with JWT verification disabled, set OTP_AES_KEY (and mail secrets), confirm EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / anon key, and retry or try another browser without extensions blocking requests.

errors.mfaEmailFailedHintMissingResend: In Supabase → Project Settings → Edge Functions → Secrets, set RESEND_API_KEY (from resend.com). The Expo app .env cannot supply this—the function runs only on Supabase. Add RESEND_FROM_EMAIL if you use a verified domain sender, OTP_AES_KEY, and ALLOW_CONSOLE_OTP=true for dev OTP-in-logs only.
errors.mfaEmailFailedHintResendRejected: Open Resend → Logs for the exact API error. Confirm the API key matches the secrets on the deployed superadmin-mfa function, and that your recipient address is allowed for your "From" domain.
errors.mfaEmailFailedHintResendTestingDomain: Mail is sending from Resend's test address (default: onboarding@resend.dev). Resend only delivers those messages to addresses allowed under your testing rules (often only your Resend account email)—not arbitrary inboxes. Add a verified domain in Resend, then set secret RESEND_FROM_EMAIL (e.g. MyTuition <noreply@your-domain.com>).
errors.mfaEmailFailedHintResendUnverifiedDomain: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL must use a domain you have verified in Resend (DNS). Either verify the domain and set RESEND_FROM_EMAIL accordingly, or temporarily use onboarding@resend.dev and deliver only to permitted test recipients.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how MyTuition (operated by Wovello Software Solutions, Sri Lanka) collects and uses personal data. Contact: info@wovello.com, +94 701284492.
privacy.s1Body: We may collect your name, NIC, mobile number, and email. Payment details are collected only as needed to process payments through PayHere.
privacy.s2Body: We share relevant account information with institutes you are linked to through account linking. We share data with PayHere and SMSlenz only as needed to process payments and send SMS.
privacy.s3Body: Student details may be shared with teachers only for linked classes (for example attendance for that class). Other class details for a student are shown only to the teacher of that class. Teacher details may be shared with a linked institute only as needed. The same limited sharing applies between institutes and students through account linking.
